stories.title: The Solo Trial-Firm Engine: How I Ship Fast Without Burning Out
stories.snippet: A complete blueprint of how a solo engineering trial-firm tests viable business models before writing massive lines of non-scalable architecture.
stories.author: Created by Anandovsky
stories.content:
A complete blueprint of how a solo engineering trial-firm tests viable business models before writing massive lines of non-scalable architecture.

Phase 1: Zero-Capital Hypotheses

Never write backend services for an audience that doesn't exist yet.

"Velocity of validation is the only real moat in solo venture engineering."

stories.title: Upgrading FreeIt to Android 16 (API 36): Production Lessons Learned
stories.snippet: A deep dive into navigating Google Play's 2026 target SDK requirements, handling edge-to-edge system insets, and optimizing WebView render trees.
stories.author: Created by Anandovsky
stories.content:
Targeting Android 16 (API level 36) requires adhering to modern permission models and edge-to-edge window insets.

Key Engineering Shifts

1. Target API Level 36 compatibility flags.

2. Hardware-accelerated canvas layers.

stories.title: 🌱 Pressure-Free Testing: Empowering Student QA Leads with Zero Deadlines
stories.snippet: Why flexible, self-paced testing produces higher quality bug reports than artificial deadlines. A model for asynchronous student collaboration.
stories.author: Created by Anandovsky
stories.content:
Testing should never conflict with university exams or coursework. Our collaborators (Johnny hotbody (nick), Gayathri) contribute purely at their own pace.

"No monthly or yearly targets. True quality emerges when contributors test with genuine curiosity."
